# Keyza Zaki Arkana — Portfolio

> Keyza Zaki Arkana is a software engineer based in Tasikmalaya, Indonesia, building modern, high-performance web applications with Vue/Nuxt, Laravel, and Tailwind CSS.

This site is the personal portfolio and contact point for Keyza Zaki Arkana. It presents selected project case studies, a short biography, the tools and technologies he works with, a professional journey, and a contact form.

## Main

- [Portfolio home](https://keyzar.my.id/): Overview of Keyza Zaki Arkana and his work.
- [Selected work](https://keyzar.my.id/#work): Case studies of shipped projects, including scope, stack, and outcomes.
- [About](https://keyzar.my.id/#about): Background, focus areas, and how he works.
- [Tools](https://keyzar.my.id/#tools): Languages, frameworks, and platforms he uses day to day.
- [Journey](https://keyzar.my.id/#journey): Education, internships, competitions, and roles.
- [Blog](https://keyzar.my.id/#blog): Short notes and field journal entries.
- [Contact](https://keyzar.my.id/#contact): Send a message directly.
